source: ESPN rosters and season-scoped core statistics
scope: Upcoming fixture teams only; latest available ESPN season snapshot, not historical

limitations.assists: Unavailable in verified ESPN soccer fields; NULL is not zero
limitations.recentForm: Not available until verified match-by-match history is collected

limitations.lineup: Roster membership does not establish match starting XI

limitations.seasonStatus: Latest ESPN season year is not verified as currently active
limitations.backtesting: Never use a current player snapshot for past fixtures
